push.baseUrlExtra: The unified official entry for community push and the theme market; the theme module uses this URL as well
push.siteUrlExtra: Used to build the "Read More" link of pushed content
push.pushKeyExtra: Generate it in the NovaBlog personal center under "Push Key". Only the prefix is shown after saving; the full key is never displayed again
push.pushKeyKeep: Leave empty to keep the existing key
push.pushKeyPlaceholder: Generated in the NovaBlog personal center, starts with nbk_
push.verifyCodeExtra: Copy it from the NovaBlog community under "Personal Settings → Bind Blog". Saving confirms blog ownership with the community automatically; once verified, the community account gets the "Owner" badge
push.verifyCodePlaceholder: Paste the code shown on the community personal settings page

syncTooltip.default: Push this content to the NovaBlog community; later changes will sync automatically
syncTooltip.synced: Published on the community; later changes in the CMS sync automatically
syncTooltip.hidden: Unpublished from the community; click to push and publish again
syncTooltip.unpublished: Only published content can be pushed to the community

modal.unpublishContent: Community readers will no longer see it, but community data is kept. Push again to restore. Unpublish now?

message.saveVerified: Push settings saved; blog ownership verified
message.saveVerifyFailed: Push settings saved, but blog ownership verification failed
message.verifyRejected: The verification code was rejected by the community
message.noChanges: No changes; the community is already up to date
